title: Blur Is the Shortcut. Depth Is the Skill.
excerpt: Background blur is the shortcut everyone learns first. Photographer Max Kent argues that real depth comes from directional light and layered composition — and phones have been faking bokeh since 2016.

title: Old Glass, Sharper Photographer
excerpt: Travis Butler shoots a Sigma fp and Lumix S5 with adapted film-era lenses. His reason is not nostalgia: a decade of manual focus forced him to truly understand aperture and the focal plane.

title: The Finish Is a Decision
excerpt: Lightroom on mobile can now open closed eyes and expand your photos with generative AI. Useful tools — and a test of honesty, because one of them invents parts of your photograph.
